exclusions.rationale: Installed dependency bytes are external to the repository certificate; package.json and package-lock.json retain their reproducible identities.
Git object and worktree metadata are repository transport state, not release-control inputs.
Ephemeral transaction downloads and cleanup state are represented by the checked-in native provenance receipt and its bound hashes.
Session planning and execution outputs do not control the packaged release.
Coverage output is derived test telemetry.
Runtime logs are derived diagnostics and do not control release execution.
Cargo target directories are local compiler output; Cargo manifests, lockfile, Rust sources, and checked-in release bytes are retained.
